summary: 36 static meshes of the unclaimed gate 2 families that families.json binds, each with one baked opaque set (BC / N OpenGL / ORM). Every FBX holds one object named after the asset (LOD0 only) and, where collision_hulls is 1, a UCX hull that the importer drops: the family layer is visual only.
